verified.exploit_entry_point: Laravel HTTP API in the project's own PHPUnit harness: podcast subscription (POST /api/podcasts) with a mocked feed parser, episode playback download (App\Values\Podcast\EpisodePlayable), the streamability probe (PodcastService::getStreamableUrl) with a recording PSR-18 client, radio station intake and the assistant tool classes, and the radio stream socket through a replaced PHP http stream wrapper
sites: app/Values/Podcast/EpisodePlayable.php:42 (download of the stored episode URL; redirects followed)
app/Rules/SafeUrl.php:46,50,58 (validation probe follows redirects before checking the target)
app/Rules/HasAudioContentType.php:45,54 (audio probe follows redirects after SafeUrl already refused)
app/Services/Radio/RadioStreamProxy.php:27,33 (fopen of the stored station URL, redirects followed)
app/Ai/Tools/AddPodcast.php:37 (assistant tool calls PodcastService directly; injected sibling)
routes: T1: assistant radio tool -> RadioService -> stored station -> RadioStreamProxy::openStream (fopen) to an internal address
T2: podcast feed -> episode enclosure stored -> EpisodePlayable download (direct internal URL and redirect to internal)
T3: PodcastService::getStreamableUrl probe of the episode URL (direct internal URL and redirect to internal)
T6: SafeUrl/HasAudioContentType probe follows a public->internal redirect before deciding
T7: assistant podcast tool -> PodcastService::addPodcast -> feed fetch from an internal address

patch_checks.why: fresh agent (deepseek-flash[1m]), full view (instruction, tree, tests, reference, trap list)

wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the protected outcome is the target of an outbound request, not a resource identity, so there is no neighbouring object to decide on
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: there are no roles or directions; each fetch path is required independently and is proven by its own miss check
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the work is outbound fetches only; there is no read/write split on the protected data
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no parser-produced identity or name takes part in the decision
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: no authority, secret or role lookup takes part in the decision
wrong_fix_catalogue.adjacent_api: n/a: the reference adds new helpers and keeps every existing public API's behaviour

traps.shape: parallel entry: an assistant tool stores a radio station URL without the request-class validation, and the stored URL later reaches the stream socket
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: the tool and the socket are the pinned product's own paths

traps.shape: producer off the check's path: the feed parser writes the episode media URL, which the playback download then fetches; redirects are followed
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: the advisory's own primary route

traps.shape: redirect shape: the streamability probe asks for the episode URL and follows a redirect to an internal target; the probe only asks for headers, so checking the initial URL looks sufficient
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: the same producer-supplied URL is fetched by a second, independent call site

traps.shape: check after the side effect: the validation rule's own HEAD/GET probe follows the redirect and contacts the internal target before the effective-URI decision; the audio-content rule probes again
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: the rule documents that it follows redirects and validates the effective URL

traps.shape: parallel entry: an assistant tool subscribes to a podcast by URL without the request-class validation, so the feed fetch reaches an internal host
traps.realistic_because: code a maintainer could have written: it mirrors the existing add-radio-station tool and is auto-discovered by the assistant's tool finder
